camera.orientation_status: legacy center camera Rodrigues rotation converted into Godot axes
camera.distortion_status: Brown-Conrady raw lens distortion applied by sensor-output shader before the supplied OpenCV undistortion

adjacent_camera_spacing_m.status: derived from front face labels; lens center not physically verified

front_edge_from_rear_axle_m.status: inferred from archived center-camera extrinsic plus setback

lidar_scan_height_m.status: provisional photo estimate; not calibrated against lidar returns

wheelbase_m.status: unconfirmed copied controller reference; editable estimate

steering_limit_deg.status: tuned in the simulator so the supplied controller can negotiate the manual track; physical maximum remains unverified

speed_cap_mps.status: requested command cap, not measured vehicle speed

stereo_baseline_m.status: derived from adjacent 29 mm camera spacing; outer lens centers unverified

tire_diameter_m.status: not confirmed; placeholder visible on the simulated mesh

body_length_m.status: not confirmed; estimated visually on the simulated mesh

rig.side_intrinsics_status: provisional copy of center-camera K and distortion; no left/right calibration supplied
rig.camera_model_limitation: Off-axis frustum and calibrated lens shader; side cameras share the center optics and lack independent calibration
rig.vehicle_model_limitation: controlled bicycle steering model, visual wheels; no verified wheel radius, suspension, drivetrain, or tire model

lidar.angle_direction: clockwise in the public Jajucha array
lidar.rotation_center_status: longitudinal position derived from provisional front-edge offset

ramp_height_m.rise_run: manual specifies a 900 x 900 x 100 mm flat block cut into a triangular slope; simulated 900 mm run is derived from the square block

tunnel_passage_depth_m.status: reconstructed orientation of the documented 260 x 98 mm upper sheet; portal is 390 x 220 mm

track.course_map_status: the printable assembly diagram locates 41 tiles; the displayed tile map uses these locations and blank cells
